extensions.author: vlad-terin
extensions.readme:
# A/B Test

Whether an A/B test's difference is real, as a card while you type - the lift, the confidence and the p-value - and how many visitors a test needs.

## Type

- “ab 120/2400 vs 150/2380”
- “sample size 4% baseline 10% lift”
- “sample size 4% baseline 1% lift absolute”

The test is a two-sided z-test on the two conversion rates; 95% confidence (p < 0.05) is called significant. The sample size is per variant, for 95% confidence and 80% power; a lift is relative unless “absolute” follows it. ↵ copies the verdict.

## Reaches

Nothing: it is worked out on your Mac. It changes nothing.

extensions.author: vlad-terin

# Clinical Calculators

BMI with body surface area, a due date from the last period, and creatinine clearance (Cockcroft-Gault), as cards while you type - worked out on your Mac.

## Type

- “bmi 180 cm 75 kg”
- “bmi 5'11 170 lb”
- “due date lmp 2026-03-01”
- “edd lmp mar 1”
- “crcl 65 years 70 kg creatinine 1.2 male”

Each card names its formula: BMI with WHO bands and body surface area by Mosteller, the due date by Naegele's rule (last period + 280 days) with the weeks along today, and creatinine clearance by Cockcroft-Gault on actual body weight. A creatinine above 30 is read as µmol/L. These are calculators, not medical advice. ↵ copies the line.

## Reaches

Nothing: it is worked out on your Mac. It changes nothing.

# Email Setup

Who runs a domain's email and whether it is set up to be trusted, as a card while you type: the provider, SPF, DMARC and DKIM.

## Type

- “email setup github.com”
- “dmarc stripe.com”
- “spf example.org”
- “mx acme.com”

The provider comes from the MX records (Google Workspace, Microsoft 365, Proofpoint, Mimecast and others). SPF shows whether it ends strict (-all), soft (~all) or open. DMARC shows its policy (none, quarantine, reject). DKIM is looked for at the common selectors (google, selector1, selector2, …), so a key at another selector is not seen. ↵ copies the records.

## Reaches

The DNS servers your Mac uses. It changes nothing.

- “whois github.com”
- “rdap example.org”
- “is jevie.ai available”

↵ copies the line: `github.com · MarkMonitor Inc. · expires 2026-10-09 (in 362 days)`. The days left turn into a warning under 30. Each domain is kept a day.
